key.name: max-items
key.description: How many copies to keep in the history, from most recent to oldest.

key.name: toggle-clippo
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Clippo popup.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show icon in the top bar
key.description: Shows an icon in the GNOME panel to open the history with the mouse.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When on, clipboard capture is paused and nothing new is stored.

key.name: capture-primary
key.description: Also store text selected with the mouse (middle-click), not only Ctrl+C copies.

key.name: trim-whitespace
key.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from captured text.

key.name: order-by-recent-use
key.description: Sort the history by last use instead of by when it was copied.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: Application ids or window classes whose copies are not stored.

key.name: capture-images
key.description: Store copied images (PNG) in the history, in addition to text.

key.name: detect-types
key.description: Recognize links, colors and emails to show an icon and offer quick actions.
